a: 5-year AEI-funded contract, gross €40,000/yr, at least €200,000 research funding; permanent USC position after positive evaluation
dt: AEI application window 10 Nov to 10 Dec 2026, 14:00 CET
e: IGFAE invites applicants to the national Spanish Ramón y Cajal 2026 call naming IGFAE as host, in astrophysics and cosmology, particle, nuclear, astroparticle physics and quantum information; IGFAE expects to host two or more successful candidates. Applicants need a PhD awarded between 1 Jan 2013 and 31 Dec 2024 (extensions possible); selection is by the national agency AEI.
f: Galician Institute of High Energy Physics (IGFAE), University of Santiago de Compostela
n: IGFAE (Universidade de Santiago de Compostela): Ramón y Cajal 2026 tenure-track positions
unv: Applications go to Spain's AEI national call, not to IGFAE directly; the AEI call page was not opened. The IGFAE gravitational-wave group posted the same call separately.
